description: Ontology schema drift against the live Portal reporting-API catalog: every served relation bound by the schema or explicitly excluded, no bound relation or column gone, catalog digest versus the pinned one. One GET /v1/relations through the read-only client; names, digests and counts only, no row values. Live-unverified until this check passes on reviewed main. A bound relation the live catalog still lists but marks unavailable (an upstream reason such as approved columns missing or not granted after a Sage full load) is a blocked_upstream part with cause relation_unavailable: the check is then blocked, never a pass, and the rest must still show no unbound relation, no unexplained missing relation and no degraded column (expect_blocked).
